whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Green Resort & Restaurant,

I noticed your resort & restaurant has a strong 4.3★ reputation with over 150 reviews in Kanhauli, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile booking and menu showcase page.

Maine aapke resort ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, party lawn inquiry, aur menu showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/greenresort

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi The Green Resort team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (The Green Resort & Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table & room booking, party lawn inquiry, and mobile-first menu display for customers in the Kanhauli area. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual property photos aur pricing integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough!
